Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the performer "Victim of Romance" as a person (Michelle Phillips) rather than an album. The first search result from WebSurfer clearly stated, "Victim of Romance is singer and songwriter Michelle Phillips 's first and only solo album." The Planner failed to recognize this distinction in the very first analysis step, leading to the erroneous conclusion that the task was to find the child of the *performer* (Michelle Phillips) instead of the child of the *album* (which has no children). This fundamental error in interpreting the subject of the query propagated through all subsequent steps.
